solution.p: z =- \sqrt{49-x^2 - y^2} and z = \sqrt{49-x^2 - y^2} represent, respectively, the lower and upper part of the sphere x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 49.
In spherical coordinates, the sphere has equation \rho = 7.
y =- \sqrt{49-x^2} and y = \sqrt{49-x^2 } represent, respectively, the lower and upper part of the circle x^2 + y^2 = 49, which is the intersection of the sphere \rho = 7 with the xy-plane.
Since 0 \le x \le 7, the region of integration consists of the hemisphere \rho = 7 with x > 0.
